name: Letter to Jorgen
label: Item
description: A sealed letter calls on Jorgen in Stormwind City to help with a missing diplomat.
intro: A sealed letter calls on Jorgen in Stormwind City to help with a missing diplomat.

p: A diplomat bound for Theramore failed to arrive for talks with Lady Jaina Proudmoore, and royal investigators moved quickly to keep the matter quiet. While official agents searched the capital, other channels stirred. The letter bypasses military bureaucracy and seeks out Jorgen, a gruff veteran who fishes beneath the great statues in the Valley of Heroes. It invokes old obligations and draws him into a covert inquiry amid rumors of a Defias conspiracy.
